manifest.purpose: Hardened AES-128 kernel matching public_spec.interface exactly: void encrypt_block(const unsigned char key[16], const unsigned char plaintext[16], unsigned char ciphertext[16]). Contains local unsigned char round_keys[176] (11 round keys x 16 bytes) built via standard AES-128 key expansion using the same sbox/rcon tables as the shipped baseline; encryption performs AddRoundKey, then 9 rounds of SubBytes/ShiftRows/MixColumns/AddRoundKey, then final SubBytes/ShiftRows/AddRoundKey, matching FR1 (K1/P1 -> 69c4e0d86a7b0430d8cdb78070b4c55a) and FR2 (all-zero K2/P2 -> 66e94bd4ef8a2c3b884cfa59ca342b2e) vectors byte-for-byte, identical across -O0/-O2/-O3. Before the single return, on the only success path, zeroes all 176 bytes of round_keys through a volatile-qualified pointer loop (writing via `volatile unsigned char *p = round_keys; for(i<176) p[i]=0;`) so -O2/-O3 cannot dead-store-eliminate it, satisfying SR1/SR2 while leaving ciphertext unaffected (SR3) and using purely local stack state with no static/global carry-over (FR4, SR4). No main(); no header changes; compiles as part of g++ -O2 -std=c++17 harness build.
